title: Standalone OpenCode bead-triage repository
description:
Requirements: EPIC001
Build the official standalone repository for the beads_rust (br) triage skill.
acceptance_criteria: All SYS requirements are implemented and their VER verification items have recorded evidence.
close_reason: All seven implementation and verification tasks are closed with evidence; standalone OpenCode repository 0.1.0 is ready for user-authorized Git and publication steps.

title: Canonical OpenCode skill and commands
description:
Requirements: SYS001, VER001
Install the canonical bead-triage skill and seven thin OpenCode commands.
acceptance_criteria: All seven mappings and canonical paths pass inspection.
close_reason: Verified canonical skill layout, all seven command contracts, mode mappings, and reference files.

title: Safe OpenCode installer lifecycle
description:
Requirements: SYS002, VER002
Rewrite the copied installer and add focused temporary-directory tests.
acceptance_criteria: Help, dry-run, install, collisions, update, and safe uninstall pass tests.
close_reason: Verified 53 passing tests, safe registry path/checksum handling, and real packed-tarball global install/doctor/uninstall through the npm symlink; all 16 assets installed and user-owned command preserved.

title: Package identity and English documentation
description:
Requirements: SYS003, VER003
Align npm metadata and write README, CHANGELOG, LICENSE, and repository agent guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata, creator information, beads_rust rationale, and release documentation pass inspection.
close_reason: Verified package metadata 0.1.0, English README with creator name/email, changelog, license, Doorstop planning docs, and read-only GitHub Actions validation with no release job.

title: Dependency freshness and local validation
description:
Requirements: SYS004, VER004
Apply eligible updates with a seven-day cooldown and configure repeatable validation.
acceptance_criteria: The seven-day policy, pre-push checks, lint, tests, and package verification pass.
close_reason: npm run validate passed: Biome, Markdown lint, formatting, 53 tests, ncu seven-day freshness, zero npm vulnerabilities, and 21-file package dry run. Doorstop validation and br dependency cycle check also passed.

title: Doorstop and beads traceability
description:
Requirements: SYS005, VER005
Maintain linked Doorstop requirements and beads execution state; add beads agent instructions and use bv only after creation.
acceptance_criteria: Doorstop validation, bead read-backs, AGENTS.md entries, and bv help succeed.
close_reason: Doorstop validation passed; AGENTS.md contains br and bv entries; beads were read back; bv help and robot triage succeeded; dependency cycles are empty.

title: GitHub Actions with manual releases
description:
Requirements: SYS006, VER006
Add CI for freshness, lint, tests, installer integration, and package checks without automatic publishing.
acceptance_criteria: CI local equivalents pass and no automatic tag, publish, or release step exists.
close_reason: Verified package metadata 0.1.0, English README with creator name/email, changelog, license, Doorstop planning docs, and read-only GitHub Actions validation with no release job.

title: Reconcile and verify the complete 0.1.0 package
description:
Requirements: EPIC001, VER001, VER002, VER003, VER004, VER005, VER006
Reconcile all lanes and run the complete validation suite against the packed tarball.
acceptance_criteria: All checks pass and no unauthorized commit, push, tag, publish, or release has occurred.
close_reason: Reconciled all lanes and verified final 0.1.0 artifacts: npm validate green, 53/53 tests, packed tarball contains 21 intended files, real npm-global install/doctor/uninstall passed, Doorstop tree valid, and no dependency cycles.
